description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) through 12 cm of pigtail, an unidentified SAW filter and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz)

chain.name: 12 cm pigtail from the Si5351 board to the SAW filter
chain.notes: the same pigtail as used on 2m and 6m; type not recorded

chain.name: SAW filter
chain.notes: wide passband, about 421-444 MHz at -3 dB (measured 2026-10-31)

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

notes: Compare with 70cm-saw-unknown-10dB (the same chain without the pigtail). Only the pigtail is added. The Si5351 output goes straight into the SAW. Levels in the results are as read by the analyser; pad_db is added back to get the level leaving the filter. The attenuator is marked 10 dB but measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz (2026-10-31), so pad_db is 25.8.
